articles.title: USACE Manager of the Year: Jisun Kang leads Far East District contracting
articles.summary: Jisun Kang, chief of contracting at the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Far East District, has been named Manager of the Year through the USACE Excellence in Contracting Awards Program.

articles.title: Brunson Challenges Logisticians to Bring Modern Technology into Exercises at 10th UNC Logistics Symposium
articles.summary: U.S. Army Gen. Xavier T. Brunson, commander of United Nations Command, told logisticians from 15 nations that sustainment is central to winning, as he opened the 10th Annual UNC Logistics Symposium at the Morning Calm Conference Center, Oct. 26, 2026.

articles.title: KEEN SWORD 27: 3rd EOD Company and Japan Ground Self-Defense Force EOD conducts live fire ground response training
articles.summary: U.S. Marines with 3rd Explosive Ordnance Disposal Company, 9th Engineer Support Battalion, 3rd Marine Logistics Group, trained alongside Japan Ground Self-Defense Force members during a bilateral live-fire ground response training on Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 23, 2026.

articles.title: TAMC physician honored for 30 years of continued Army service
articles.summary: Tripler Army Medical Center, HI — Dr. Conrad S. Belnap, a physician at Tripler Army Medical Center, received a medallion from the U.S. Army Medical Department on Oct. 19 in recognition of completing 30 years of active-duty service in the U.S. Army Medical Corps.

articles.title: Deckplates to Dugouts: JFK Sailor balances Navy life and Softball
articles.summary: U.S. Navy Retail Services Specialist (RS) 2nd Class Adrian Ramos, from Puerto Rico, still remembers the electric hum of draft day; the phone call, the handshake, the dream that had carried him from Miami Dade College to the Toronto Blue Jays organization starting in the minor leagues, but life has a way of shifting the field beneath your cleats.

articles.title: Treating Guard families with spooktacular fun & resources
articles.summary: Over 1,000 Utah National Guard family members came to Camp Wiliams on 17 October, 2026 as the Utah National Guard Child and Youth Programs hosted its annual Trunk or Treat.

articles.title: Guardsmen Push Through the Exhaustion in the 2027 Best Warrior Competition
articles.summary: The 2027 Utah Best Warrior Competition brought together 21 Utah Army and Air National Guardsmen at Camp Williams Oct. 19-21, 2026, for three days of challenges testing physical endurance, tactical proficiency and mental resilience.

articles.title: US Air Force awards Lockheed Martin $694M hypersonic missile production contract
articles.summary: The Air Force granted Lockheed Martin a $694 million contract in late September for the production and fielding of the AGM-183A Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon, or ARRW.

articles.title: La. Guard leaders address readiness, transformation at annual conference
articles.summary: NEW ORLEANS – The Louisiana National Guard held its annual Command and Staff Conference at Jackson Barracks in New Orleans, Oct. 17-18, bringing together brigade and battalion command teams and senior headquarters leaders from across the organization.

articles.title: Pentagon creates advisory council on human performance, health
articles.summary: After creating a new directorate on warfighter optimization within the Department of Defense, the Pentagon announced it will form a federal advisory committee to weigh in on issues affecting troop performance and health.

articles.title: US Army queries industry’s ability to build 21,000 Infantry Squad Vehicles
articles.summary: The U.S. Army published a market survey Monday in an effort to learn whether the defense industrial base could deliver 9,000 ISV-9s and about 12,000 ISV-Us.

articles.title: Corps of Engineers, city of Wabasha, Minnesota, reach milestone with river sand management
articles.summary: ST. PAUL, Minn. – The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, St. Paul District, and the city of Wabasha, Minnesota, reached a major milestone last week in the management of Mississippi River sand removed from the navigation channel.

articles.title: MV-75 Cheyenne gains Soldier insights during sixth Special User Evaluation
articles.summary: Aviators from the Operational Development Team (ODT) and Soldiers representing the National Guard State Army Aviation Office (SAAO) Advisory Council Working Group participated in the sixth MV-75 Cheyenne Special User Evaluation (SUE) Aug. 24–28, 2026.

articles.title: Col. Brewer assumes command of Fort Buchanan, emphasizes readiness and community partnership
articles.summary: Service members, civilians and families gathered at the installation's community club Oct. 27 to witness Col. David L. Brewer assume command of U.S. Army Garrison Fort Buchanan, marking a leadership transition focused on sustaining military readiness and strengthening the installation's strategic role in the Caribbean.

articles.title: What’s haunting the Pentagon this Halloween?
articles.summary: Three special guests, and Mark, share a few frightening mysteries from their beats — from the dangers of war in space to the intricacies of upgrading America’s nuclear weapons.

articles.title: US Army looks to high-flying balloons to help see, strike along front lines with China
articles.summary: Amid renewed interest in high-altitude balloons, soldiers are looking to them to extend their reach along the first island chain.
